clue.text: Risk taken by the novice in church

parts.note: to risk something is to chance it
L is the learner plate sign, so it stands for a novice

explanation.surface: A gamble made by a beginner while in a place of worship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken by' simply attaches the novice to the risk; 'in' links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The chancel is the part of a church near the altar, so the word names a section of the building.

clue.text: Soldiers in bistros ordering bottles

indicators.note: in places the soldiers inside the bistros

parts.note: a bistro is a small cafe
RA is the Royal Artillery, a British army regiment

explanation.surface: Troops ordering wine by the jug in French restaurants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordering' is surface padding linking to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A carafe is a glass vessel for serving wine or water, a kind of bottle.

clue.text: Refrain that can make a seaman turn colour!

parts.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman
to stain is to discolour or turn a different colour

explanation.surface: A song chorus that can make a sailor blush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refrain' looks like a noun, a chorus, but it is the verb meaning hold back.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to hold back from doing something, the verb sense of refrain.

clue.text: Caution should be used about opposing cut

indicators.note: about tells us the caution goes round the opposing letter

parts.note: care means caution
V is short for versus, against or opposing

explanation.surface: Be careful when you're up against someone with a knife.
explanation.definitionFit: To carve is to cut meat or wood into slices or shapes.

clue.text: Buffet having difficulty providing illumination

parts.note: to lam is to strike, as to buffet is to hit
a plight is a predicament or difficulty

explanation.surface: A struggling buffet meal provides the lighting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Buffet' suggests food, but it is the verb meaning hit.
explanation.definitionFit: Light from a lamp is a source of brightness.

clue.text: One father in dreadful mess responsible for hold-up

parts.note: one is I as a Roman numeral

indicators.note: in tells us the father goes inside the jumbled mess
dreadful suggests the word mess is put into a bad, jumbled state

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A single dad stuck in a terrible muddle causes a delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' turns MESS into MSSE, and 'in' puts PA inside it after I; 'responsible for' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A deadlock is a situation where progress stops, which is a hold-up or stoppage.

clue.text: Popular group is let in

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A well-liked band is admitted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inset has been inserted into a surrounding piece, set or put into it.

clue.text: Convicts a boy entrapped by spies

indicators.note: entrapped by places the boy inside the spies

parts.note: priers are people who pry, spying
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Inmates held a lad caught by secret agents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Convicts' looks like a verb, but it is the noun for jailed people.
explanation.definitionFit: Convicts are people serving jail sentences, held captive.

clue.text: Entertainers taking pains — or otherwise

indicators.note: otherwise signals the letters of pains and or arranged differently

explanation.surface: Performers going to great lengths, or not.
explanation.definitionFit: Soprani are the highest singers, performers who entertain an audience.

clue.text: Time for getting level

definitions.meaning: the period at the end of day

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a noun for the late part of the day and a verb form meaning making equal.

clue.text: The beak making a stand

definitions.meaning: in zoology a ... is a bird's bill or similar snout
a raised platform for a speaker

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a bird's bill in biology and a speaker's platform, originally from ships' prows displayed in Rome.

clue.text: A dotty way to do the decorating!

definitions.text: A dotty way to do the decorating!

parts.words: A dotty way to do the decorating!
parts.note: dotty seems to mean crazy, but it means literally made with dots: a painting technique applying many small dabs

explanation.definitionFit: Stippling is a painting method using small dots or dabs of colour.

clue.text: One may produce notes on the French bean

definitions.meaning: a small flute-like wind instrument plays notes
a kind of kidney bean popular in France

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a small fipple flute and a type of haricot bean.

clue.text: Set right a sanctimonious beast

parts.note: OK means all correct, set right
taken as written
pi is short for pious, sanctimonious

explanation.surface: A pious, self-righteous animal is put in order.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi is an African animal related to the giraffe, so it is a beast.

clue.text: Not all of those chosen seek recognition

indicators.note: only part of the words those chosen seek is used, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Only some of the elect seek to be acknowledged.
explanation.definitionFit: Sense can mean awareness or perception, as in having a sense of something, which is recognition.

clue.text: Perpetually gullible, so maybe box

parts.note: ever means always or perpetually
green means naive or gullible

explanation.surface: Always naive, so perhaps up for a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' suggests boxing, but it is the box shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: Box is a shrub that keeps its leaves all year, an example of the class.

clue.text: Down-to earth activity which is growing

definitions.text: Down-to earth activity which is growing

parts.words: Down-to earth activity which is growing
parts.note: down-to-earth seems to mean practical, but it means literally working in soil, and growing means raising plants rather than increasing

explanation.definitionFit: Tending plants in the soil is a hobby literally done down in the earth while things grow.

clue.text: Leftist movement creating work for the editor

parts.note: a red is a communist, a leftist
action is movement or activity

explanation.surface: A left-wing campaign gives an editor something to do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'creating' links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Redaction is the editing or preparing of a text for publication.

clue.text: Wouldn't allow car-park opening amid tall grass

parts.note: P is the map symbol for a car park

indicators.note: amid says the opening sits in the middle of the tall grass

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass growing by water
a vent is an opening or outlet

explanation.surface: Someone refused entry to a car park entrance hidden in long grass.
explanation.definitionFit: To have stopped something happening is to have not let it go ahead.

clue.text: The fool retired and the wise man's going

indicators.note: retired means gone back, so the fool's word is read in reverse

parts.note: a sap is a fool
a sage is a wise man

explanation.surface: The idiot has stepped back and the sage is leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: A passage can mean the act of passing or moving through, a going.

clue.text: Odd characters are each making personal complaint

indicators.note: odd signals that the letters of are each are put into a strange order

explanation.surface: Strange people each make their own grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' and 'making' are surface padding linking to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Pain in one's own ear is a physical ailment, a complaint in the medical sense.

clue.text: The body politic say

definitions.meaning: a nation as an organised political community

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a noun for a political nation and a verb meaning declare.

clue.text: The goddess wanting a pastry in quarters

indicators.note: in places the pastry between the quarters

parts.note: S and E are compass quarters, south and east
a tart is a pastry

explanation.surface: A deity asking for a pie in her lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarters' looks like lodgings but means compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: Astarte was the Phoenician goddess of fertility and love.

clue.text: Oriental getting a note back

parts.note: E is a musical note
astern means at or towards the back of a ship

explanation.surface: An easterner receiving a message in return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' suggests a letter, but it is a musical note; 'back' is a word for the rear, not a reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriental is an old adjective meaning of the East.

clue.text: Youngster given direction by a prude

parts.note: S is south, a compass direction
a prig is a self-righteous, prudish person

explanation.surface: A child guided by a prim moralist.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprig, besides a twig, is an informal word for a young person, a scion of a family.

clue.text: One in fifty reprimands will bring tears

indicators.note: in places the one inside the run of fifty and reprimands

parts.note: L is fifty in Roman numerals
to rate is an old word for scold
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.surface: One telling-off out of fifty will make someone cry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tears' is read as crying, but it means rips.
explanation.definitionFit: To lacerate is to rip flesh, so the verb names causing rips or gashes.

clue.text: Alter possibly — but not yet

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters of alter could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Perhaps change something, but not now.
explanation.definitionFit: Afterwards, at some future time, means not at present.

clue.text: Some people will strive never to cause split

indicators.note: only some letters of strive never are used, a run within them

explanation.surface: Certain people try never to cause a rift.
explanation.definitionFit: Riven is the past participle of rive, meaning torn apart.

clue.text: Getting a cent in change is not new!

indicators.note: change suggests the letters of a cent in are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Receiving a cent as your change is nothing novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' looks like coins given back, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something very old is the opposite of new, a synonym relation.

clue.text: Poetically presented back-to front

definitions.meaning: written as poetry, in two words

explanation.definitionFit: Split as two words it means set as poetry; as one word it means reversed in order.

clue.text: The Spanish are no twisters, the old queen found

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

indicators.note: twisters suggests the words are no are twisted into another arrangement

explanation.surface: Discovering that Spaniards are not cheats, says a former monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisters' turns ARE NO into EANOR; 'found' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleanor of Aquitaine and Eleanor of Castile were medieval English queens consort.

clue.text: A woman intent on obtaining material

parts.note: Nan is a woman's name
keen means eager or intent

explanation.surface: A lady determined to get some fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Nankeen is a yellowish cotton cloth originally from Nanjing, so it is a fabric.
